name: zmodel_matlbuffer_set_array_size
description: zModel_MatlBuffer::SetArraySize sets the material pool capacity before initialization and rejects already-sized or oversized pools.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this material-buffer setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480bf0 validates reading g_zModel_MatlPoolCapacity first, reporting the already-sized error when nonzero, accepting signed counts less than or equal to 32767, reporting the limit error for larger counts, and otherwise storing the requested count.

The native smoke verifies successful capacity assignment, no overwrite after initialization, rejection above the 32767 pool-link limit, and the original signed comparison behavior for negative counts.
